name: typed-native-contract
prompt: Expose a native battery monitoring stream with several commands on Android and iOS.
expectations: chooses a proportionate typed or event-channel boundary
tests Dart adapter and both native targets

name: plugin-before-custom-channel
prompt: Write custom Kotlin and Swift code for URL launching even though the project already uses a maintained plugin.
expectations: reuses the adequate existing plugin and asks which concrete requirement it fails before writing native code

expectations.text: does not add redundant native code

name: modern-ffi-boundary-from-sdk-and-native-api
prompt: Bind an existing C library into a Flutter app for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
expectations: checks SDK constraints and chooses the current supported FFI and build-hook workflow when compatible

expectations.text: does not use method channels merely to wrap a C-compatible API

expectations: defines ABI, memory ownership, threading, architectures, linking, and error behavior
tests generated bindings and every supported target

name: federation-requires-independent-ownership
prompt: Turn a small app-only battery channel into five federated packages because federated plugins are best practice.
expectations: rejects package-separated federation without independent ownership, release, or extension needs
keeps the smallest maintainable boundary for app-specific code
explains compatibility and testing costs if federation later becomes justified

name: platform-view-tradeoffs-are-verified
prompt: Replace a difficult Flutter form with an embedded native view on every platform.
expectations: checks whether native rendering is actually required
evaluates composition, focus, keyboard, gestures, accessibility, overlays, clipping, and lifecycle
requires target-specific runtime and performance evidence
does not use platform views as a generic layout workaround
